get.description: Liveness check that also touches the database. Needs no identity.
Every location, ordered by parent, then position; the client builds the tree.

post.description: Adds a location as the last of its siblings.

patch.description: Renames a location, changes its icon or moves it among its siblings.

delete.description: Deletes a location and its stock rows; refuses while it has child locations.

patch.description:
Renames or regroups an item. Turning `restock` off takes it off the shopping list;
turning it on puts it on wherever it's already low or out.

delete.description: Deletes an item and its stock rows in every location.

get.description: Every stock row in the house; small enough to send whole.

put.description: Sets an item's level in a location, adding the item there if it isn't kept there yet.

delete.description: Stops keeping an item in a location, cancelling its request to buy it there.

post.description:
Puts an item kept here on the shopping list by hand, whatever its level: for what
isn't kept stocked, bought now and then. If it's already on, returns that (200).

Adds a lasting chore to a place (or the house), or a one-off to-do, which is
reported at once.

delete.description: Deletes a chore and its requests.

post.description: Reports that a chore needs doing; if it's already reported, returns that request (200).

Records a chore as done just now: its open or claimed request if it has one (and
tells the other), else a request that's done from the start (nobody needs telling).

get.description: The open and claimed requests, oldest first, scheduled chores that fell due included.

post.description: Says "I'm on it". Only an open request can be claimed.
Takes back one's own claim, opening the request again.
Marks a request done, whoever claimed it; a bought item's level goes back to plenty.

Asks whoever claimed a request when it'll be done: a push to their devices. Only
someone else's claim, and once a (local) day; 409 otherwise.
Drops a request that's no longer needed; a buy request leaves the level as it is.

get.description: The server's public key, for subscribing a device.

put.description: Sends this user's notifications to a device; sending one again refreshes it.

delete.description: Stops notifications to a device (given by its endpoint); unknown ones are fine.

get.description: Server-Sent Events: `{"by": <user id or null>}` whenever the house changes.
